episodes.synopsis:
Ataru Moroboshi, an unlovely flirtatious boy, has been chosen to fight an invading alien force's champion in a 10-day game of tag. If he loses the aliens will invade Earth, but if he wins, the aliens will go home. Ataru isn't at all willing to play tag until he sees the alien's champion: the beautiful Lum.

A group of admirers of Lum try to summon her UFO back to Earth, using Ataru as bait, but instead they get an intergalactic taxi that takes them though subspace, and the fare for the taxi is the value of all the oil on the planet.
episodes.title: I'm Lum-chan the Notorious! - It's Raining Oil All Over Town

episodes.synopsis:
A peach falls from the sky, in which Lum's cousin, Ten comes out for a visit. He is capable of breathing fire and is an instant enemy to Ataru.

Ten feeds alien candy to a swallow, making it grow massively in size such that it looks like a penguin. Its appearance in school is just the start of a full day of panic.
episodes.title: Mail from Space - Ten-chan Arrives! - Mrs. Swallow and Mrs. Penguin

episodes.synopsis:
Shinobu meets upon Rei, Lum's handsome ex-fiancé, and brings him to Ataru’s house, much to the dismay of Lum.

Ataru and his friends find Rei in a restaurant. His poor Japanese being mocked makes him go wild, and as he chases the boys and Lum throughout town, the chaos grows on.
episodes.title: The Coming of Rei the Handsome Shapechanger! - Die Dreamy-Man!

episodes.synopsis:
Lum and Ten meet a vicious little boy on top of a flying bear, whom Ataru and Shinobu identify as Kintarō, who came from the sky and is lost.

Kintarō's nanny, with Ataru's help, takes the alien children on a tour of Earth and end up in a preschool where the actual Kintarō learns the myth of the real Kintarō and thus hopes to be a role-model to the kids.
episodes.title: Kintaro from the Autumn Sky! - Gonna Live Like a Man!

episodes.synopsis:
Ataru runs away from home, unable to stand the pressure of living with Lum, and bumps into a beautiful lady named Sakura, who takes him to her shrine for exorcism.

Sakura becomes Tomobiki High School’s nurse, and her beauty makes all the boys deliberately injure themselves in order to go see her. But later, they get really sick, which might be connected to Ataru, who oddly enough wants to avoid her.
episodes.title: Sakura - Raving Beauty of Mystery - Virus in Distress

episodes.synopsis:
Lum constantly interferes with Ataru's attempts to reach Shinobu by phone. By barging into their phone conversation from her UFO, it inadvertently creates a black hole that causes aircraft to vanish.

Ataru puts two mirrors together on Friday the 13th and accidentally makes a little demon appear from another dimension.
episodes.title: Black Hole Love Triangle - It's a Lovesick Little Demon!

episodes.synopsis:
Cherry gives Ataru a magical yellow ribbon, which when tied to her horns, negate Lum's powers. But will this really allow him to be happy?

After an odd loss of control of his body after dinner, Ataru finds out Lum made a voodoo doll of himself using some clay. Ataru takes advantage of the situation for revenge scheme, until it gives Lum the idea to make a Shinobu doll.
episodes.title: Electric Shocks Scare Me! - Voodoo Dolls of Vengeance

episodes.synopsis:
Ataru, Shinobu and Lum’s Stormtroopers wind up in Neptune through a portal discovered in Ataru’s closet where they are greeted by Lum’s friend Oyuki.

While in the air, Lum, Ataru, Ten and Kintaro accidentally wind up back to the dinosaur age.
episodes.title: Neptune is Beyond My Closet - That Crazy Age of the Dinosaurs

episodes.synopsis:
Ataru’s wish upon a star seems to come true as he is selected to awake the Karasutengu Princess Kurama by a kiss and mate with her for a night, but he is not her ideal man.

Still trying to cure Ataru of his lechery, Kurama uses a weird dimensional door where Ataru faces hostile versions of the girls he loves.
episodes.title: Princess Kurama, Sleeping Beauty - Athletics in Women's Hell!

episodes.synopsis: Lum's Stormtroopers devise a scheme to embarrass Ataru and get Lum to dump him by setting up a fake Christmas Eve date for him.
episodes.title: Pitter Patter Christmas Eve

episodes.synopsis: The normal cast is put into an ancient Japanese story that takes place during the Heian period, with a special guest appearance.
episodes.title: Ataru Genji Goes to the Heian Capital

episodes.synopsis:
Sakura invites Ataru and others at a local disco, which is a perfect setting for her boyfriend Tsubame to prove himself worthy of being her fiancée to Cherry by displaying his magic abilities that however go awry.

Kurama takes Ataru back in time in hope of teaching him to be her ideal man like her father.
episodes.title: Battle Royal of Love - Father You Were Strong

episodes.synopsis:
During a Hawaiian vacation at a beachside resort, the girls’ swimsuits are stolen. Could Cherry be the culprit?

Still at the resort, Sakura, Ataru and Cherry compete in an all-you-can-eat contest.
episodes.title: Hawaiian Swimsuit Thief - Full Course From Hell

episodes.synopsis:
Tomobiki High School gets a new student: Shutaro Mendo, the son of Japan's richest family. He and Ataru have a duel for presidency of the class.

After a computer told Lum that her perfect matchmade partner is Shutaro instead of Ataru, she shrinks the two down and places them on a Horoscope device.
episodes.title: Mendo Brings Trouble! - Constellation is Spinning

episodes.synopsis:
Lum takes Ataru to her home planet for the Setsubun Battle, but the game goes awry as he goes after the goddess Benten.

Benten shows up for Earth's Setsubun, and a rematch ensues as Ataru angers Lum by taking advantage to play with Benten.
episodes.title: The Great Spring War - The Benten Gang's Return Match

episodes.synopsis:
A new teacher, Sanjuro Kuribayashi, has been tasked with bringing order to Class 2-4, and he grows extremely hostile towards Ataru for being Lum’s fiancé.

During parents' visiting day, Lum's Mother and Mrs. Mendo have an all out war against each other.
episodes.title: Ah Lone Teacher! - Terrifying Visiting Day

episodes.synopsis:
Mendo brings an antique camera to school that sends Ataru off into other worlds.

Ataru strangely becomes amazingly lucky to the point that Mendo loses his popularity.
episodes.title: The Fourth Dimension Camera - Demonic Running

episodes.synopsis:
Ataru is enchanted by a doll that takes him to Ran, Lum’s childhood friend, who is not so joyful about old times when the topic of Rei comes up.

Ran invites Lum and Ataru into her spaceship for a farewell party, but Lum doesn't believe she has given up on sucking Ataru's youth.
episodes.title: Girls' Day! Introducing Ran-chan - Ran-chan's Invitation

episodes.synopsis:
Lum acquires Ataru's diary from the next day, which allows her to know what he shall go through today. Ataru tries to use it to his advantage, however...

Mendo finds an alien child in his locker and goes through great lengths to hide it from everyone.
episodes.title: The Tearful Diary of Tomorrow - Whose Kid Is This?

episodes.synopsis:
The whole Class 2-4 has fallen asleep due to a tiny spirit taking a make-up exam for her master. However, there is still Ataru, Mendō and Lum to make fall asleep.

A poetry-reading contest takes place at a blossom orchard, where it is said that a wizard of poetry uses a maiden to lure men for a poetry challenge.
episodes.title: Sleepy Serene Springtime Classroom - Peach Blossom Song Contest

episodes.synopsis:
By eating a manju Cherry intended to bury, Ataru splits into two, one polite and the other casual.

As Ataru sleeps in class after continuously losing to Lum in a card game the night before, he keeps having weird dreams until meeting a weird fellow feeding nightmares to a baku.
episodes.title: Duel! Ataru vs Ataru - Wake up to a Nightmare

episodes.synopsis: Lum returns to her home planet unaware that her father is throwing her a matchmaking party. As Ten blabs about it, Ataru uses his spaceship to follow her.
episodes.title: Great Space Matchmaking Operation

episodes.synopsis: On a school field trip, Ataru gets involved with Kappas and a limestone cavern reveals Mendo's greatest weakness.
episodes.title: Big Springtime Picnic Uproar!

episodes.synopsis: Ataru and Ten switch bodies after wearing some kind of special earmuffs.
episodes.title: Beware the Earmuffs!

episodes.synopsis: Ataru becomes the owner of a white caterpillar that Lum's Stormtroopers gave him as it eats a lot more than ordinary caterpillars.
episodes.title: Fly Imo-chan!

episodes.synopsis: Ten has an unrequited crush on Sakura.
episodes.title: Ten-chan's Love

episodes.synopsis: Dracula wants to suck the blood of a beautiful young girl and his target is Lum.
episodes.title: What a Dracula

episodes.synopsis: Lum travels back in time in order to meet a younger Ataru and cure his libido.
episodes.title: Lum's Education Lecture Course for Boys

episodes.synopsis: Ataru and Ten compete for the attention of the pretty female proprietor of a flower shop.
episodes.title: From the Gardenia with Love

episodes.synopsis: The gang meet Tsuyuko, a girl who seems to bring rain wherever she goes.
episodes.title: A Beautiful Girl Brings Rain

episodes.synopsis: Ten's horn falls off during a fight with Ataru, leaving him weak and unable to breathe fire. Ataru wastes no time in taking advantage of the situation.
episodes.title: Gimme Back My Horn!

episodes.synopsis: Chaos ensues at the library after the characters in the books start coming to life. Wendy Darling (from J.M. Barrie's Peter Pan novel) enlists Ataru and Lum's help in restoring order.
episodes.title: Shock Library - Quiet Please!

episodes.synopsis: Mr. Hanawa found employment in Ataru's school and at the same time, Lum gets enlisted into it.
episodes.title: Teacher Hanawa Arrives! It's the Youth

episodes.synopsis: A goblin who is living in Mendo's private pool has been shooed out and is trying to find a new home.
episodes.title: Goblin in Distress - Wonderful People

episodes.synopsis: Remembering how Lum always got her in trouble when they were younger, Ran devises a new scheme to suck away Ataru's youth.
episodes.title: Darling had It This Time!

episodes.synopsis: Rei appears and causes an uproar by eating everyone's lunch, and Ran tries her best to win him back.
episodes.title: Rei Returns! The Big Study Hall Uproar!

episodes.synopsis: On a cool evening disco dance held by the students at Tomobiki High School during summer break, a mysterious man comes to stalk the girls.
episodes.title: The Coming of The Phantom Red Mantle!

episodes.synopsis: Things go wrong when Lum tries to make copies of Ataru in order to protect him from Ran's vengeance.
episodes.title: Steal Darling! Copy Operation!

episodes.synopsis: Lum and Ataru go on their first date together after Lum watches a television program that makes her realize her relationship with Ataru is abnormal. Ataru, although hesitant at first, shows that he does actually have feelings for Lum, but feels uncomfortable expressing them.
episodes.title: Thrilling Summer Date

episodes.synopsis: Lum, Ataru, Shinobu and Mendo spend their summer vacation at the seaside. First they provoke the wrath of a watermelon god, then they are visited by a crying yōkai.
episodes.title: So long Byebye Summer Days

episodes.synopsis: A typhoon strikes Tomobiki and floods the Moroboshi household, but Lum has some inventive ways of helping her Darling and his parents cope with the flood waters.
episodes.title: Panic in Typhoon!

episodes.synopsis: Lum and Ten get drunk from eating umeboshi, and Lum begins flying around terrorizing Ataru's classmates in order to get more umeboshi.
episodes.title: Drunkard's Boogie

episodes.synopsis: During one of the cats' mating season, Ataru, Lum and Ten meet a beautiful female cat-like humanoid.
episodes.title: The Terror of Meow

episodes.synopsis: Lum's Stormtroopers throw Lum a party, but Ataru spoils it by yelling at Lum and accusing her of ruining his life. Lum leaves for her home planet, and when she doesn't return, Ataru, believing she has gone for good, begins to miss her and tearfully wishes she would return. However, it turns out Lum merely left to renew her passport.
episodes.title: After You've Gone

episodes.synopsis: Lum's friends from outer space plan a surprise class-reunion party for her, but an unaware Lum can't understand why her friends are avoiding her and is hurt.
episodes.title: Lum-chan's Class Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Lum, Ataru, Shinobu and the rest of the Tomobiki student body - except for Mendo and his small gang of "good kids" - fight a new school rule which forbids students to leave the campus to eat lunch at fast-food joints.
episodes.title: Those Buy-Eaters Gather Round!

episodes.synopsis: Ataru, Lum, Mendo, Shinobu, and Jariten all go on a picnic to a remote part of Japan which has some fossils. A group of archaeologists are also exploring this area and using a lot of fancy tricks to make the exploration seem more dramatic than it is.
episodes.title: Terror! The Deserted Fossil Grounds Mystery

episodes.synopsis: Kurama has her subjects place her in suspended sleep again in the hopes that some prince may awaken her.
episodes.title: Princess Kurama - A New Challenge!

episodes.synopsis: Ten has gotten cavities. However, these cavities can be cured by biting 10 people and spreading the cavities to others. To relieve himself, he pays Ataru's class a visit.
episodes.title: The Terrifying Cavity WARS!

episodes.synopsis: Mendo's manipulative and dangerous younger sister, Ryoko, is introduced.
episodes.title: The Mendo Siblings!

episodes.synopsis: Kotatsu-neko is introduced.
episodes.title: A Cat with a Grudge on the Stairs

episodes.synopsis: Ataru helps a wounded bird who transforms itself into a raccoon and moves in to repay the service to Ataru.
episodes.title: Can a Raccoon Repay a Favor!?

episodes.synopsis: Ataru finds the perfect part-time job - a washing attendant at a bathhouse - which he excitedly anticipates as being an opportunity to ogle and grope naked women. However, it doesn't turn out the way he expected.
episodes.title: The Suicide Subspace Parttime Job

episodes.synopsis: When Lum plans the class's end-of-year party, Ataru explains that New Year's is when you forget who you are. He's a bit worried she took it a bit literally...
episodes.title: The Big Year-End Party that Lum-chan Organized!
